## 主张 Claim

在已有 Process/Trace/Run 上，以每个配置中的关系表示不可分辨。旧关系为等价关系时，所有经旧登记的选择仍能经新登记表达，当且仅当新不可分辨蕴含旧不可分辨；合并一对旧差异，就有一个旧选择失去表达能力。条件沿实际中间配置组合；Web 旧选择定义直接适配。保留实际记录能保留选择并加入新差异，但记录史本身不提供记忆机制。Revising 实例的实际控制过程消耗支持形成区分关系，补充支持，然后将回应由 false 改为给定目标 true；同一过程允许关闭区分关系。区分增长不蕴含行动可执行，支持尚存也不蕴含区分尚存。 / On the existing Process/Trace/Run, relations at configurations describe indistinguishability. Where the old relation is an equivalence, every old registration-based selection is expressible through the new registration iff new indistinguishability implies old indistinguishability. A merged old pair supplies a lost choice. Preservation composes through actual intermediate configurations, with a direct adapter to Web selection. Retaining actual records keeps selections and can add distinctions, but the history itself provides no memory mechanism. The Revising instance executes a controller that consumes support to form a distinguishing link, replenishes support, then changes response from false to the supplied target true; the same process permits closing the link. Increased discrimination does not entail executable action, and remaining support does not entail remaining discrimination.

Canonical source: [Revision.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Revision.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 一般等价条件明示；过程、替代项域与各配置的登记关系给定。Trace 接续定理要求所述每一步保留区分，不宣称所有修改都如此。 / Old reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity are explicit. The process, alternative domain and registrations are supplied. The trace theorem requires preservation at the stated steps, rather than claiming every revision preserves distinctions.
- 局部实例给定支持补充、两种重构、装置与读取的对应、目标 true 及偏好重建设备的控制律。全状态中的支持量与装置状态参与控制；控制不是只经初始盲读来选择。 / The instance supplies replenishment, two rebuild modes, apparatus-to-reading correspondence, target true and a controller preferring reconstruction. Stock and apparatus status enter control; reconstruction is not chosen solely through the initially blind reading.
- 实际记忆保留、未表示后果与物理对应须另外说明；没有规范前提或普遍正成本假设。 / Actual memory retention, unrepresented effects and physical correspondence require separate accounts. No normative premise or universally positive cost is assumed.

P93 接通原共同组织研究与统一主干。登记、选择、支持和回应是同一过程中的分化关系；局部元组只保留所论连接。空 Lean 公理报告不消除构造律和目标等实质前提。作者反审说明为什么形成装置、保留记录、表达选择与实际执行不同。 / P93 connects the existing common-organization study to the unified spine. Registration, selection, support and response are differentiated relations of one process; the local tuple preserves only the stated connections. Empty Lean axiom reports do not discharge substantive construction laws or the target. Author counterreview separates apparatus formation, retained record, expressible choice and actual execution.
